dataset: Title Guaranty of Hawaii - Buyer Statistics ("Where do buyers of Hawaii property come from?")

source.latest_edition_available: Q2 2026 (Jan-Jun 2026 YTD); PDFs created 2026-08-22, last modified 2026-08-31. No Q3 2026 edition on the site as of 2026-10-08.

editions_used.2025H1: Q2 2025 (JAN-JUN 2025), PDFs dated 2025-08 (for like-for-like YTD comparison)

source.raw_dir: raw/tg/ (MANIFEST.txt lists URL, download time, bytes, sha256, server Last-Modified)
source.extraction: pdfplumber word/char coordinates (pull/tg/parse2.py), cross-read against pdftotext -layout (pull/tg/txt/)

notes: Coverage: Title Guaranty publishes four island Buyer Statistics PDFs (Oahu, Hawaii Island, Maui, Kauai). The Statewide panel is one page inside each island PDF; the four copies were compared and are identical for every period used. There are no separate Molokai or Lanai panels: Molokai and Lanai are districts inside the Maui panel (Maui County); their district totals are in editions[].districts for the Maui County entries.

Latest edition: Q2 2026 (cumulative Jan-Jun 2026), files last-modified 2026-08-31. No Q3 2026 edition was on the site on 2026-10-08; guessed Q3 2026 URLs (and statewide/Molokai/Lanai file names) redirect to the home page. Earlier posting dates (server Last-Modified): Q4 2025 on 2026-02-13, Q1 2026 on 2026-05-15, Q2 2026 on 2026-08-31.

Periods are cumulative year-to-date: the 'Q2 2026' edition covers JAN-JUN 2026 and the 'Q4' editions cover JAN-DEC. For a like-for-like 2026 YTD comparison, comparison_editions[] holds the Q2 2025 (JAN-JUN 2025) edition with its own top-10 states and countries. The Q1 2026 edition is there too as a supplement.

Buyer-origin categories are as labelled in the PDFs: HAWAII BUYERS, US BUYERS and FOREIGN BUYERS. 'US BUYERS' means buyers from other US states, because the three shares add to 100. The 'US TOTAL' row at the foot of each district page includes Hawaii buyers (for example, Oahu North Shore 2025 has US TOTAL 180, of which HI 132). Neither the PDFs nor the market page explain the method (for example whether origin comes from the buyer's mailing address, or which deed or transaction types count). Treat the figures as TG's own classification of sales.

Only the top 10 states by number of sales (Hawaii counts as rank 1) and the top foreign countries (up to 5) are published, so a full state-by-state or country-by-country sum to the totals is impossible. checks.sum_ok uses these instead: (a) island total_sales equals the sum of the district US TOTAL + FOREIGN TOTAL row; (b) the published HI / other-US / foreign sales shares match the counts within rounding; (c) the top-10 and top-country sums do not exceed their totals; (d) for Statewide, the total equals the sum of the 4 islands, the HI count equals the sum of island HI counts, and each statewide state count equals the island sum when that state is listed on all 4 island panels. All 25 edition-geography records pass.

derived_counts.foreign_buyers and other_us_buyers are not printed as headline numbers. They are computed from the district foot rows: foreign = sum of FOREIGN TOTAL; other_us = sum of US TOTAL minus the island HI count. Statewide: foreign = the sum over the 4 islands. They reproduce the published integer shares in every case.

Dollar amounts are published rounded ($X.XB / $X.XM / $X.XK). Each numeric 'dollars' field is the published rounded value converted to dollars; 'dollars_published' keeps the original string. Sums of rounded values will not exactly match the totals.

Share percentages are published integers. In the PDFs these labels appear as duplicated, offset text copies, and some pdftotext rows interleave them (for example '8811%%'). They were read from character-level data grouped by fill colour (current year vs prior year), and every copy agreed. Each edition's prior-period figures (total sales, dollars, shares) are kept in prior_period_as_republished_in_this_edition.

Revisions: prior-year totals republished in later editions differ slightly from the original edition. 2024 full year: Statewide 16,716 in the Q4 2024 edition vs 16,709 in Q4 2025; Oahu 10,607 vs 10,602; Hawaii Island 3,945 vs 3,944; Maui 1,471 vs 1,470; Kauai 693 in both. The Jan-Jun 2025 figures republished in the Q2 2026 edition match the Q2 2025 edition exactly. See revisions_between_editions.

Hawaii Island district definitions changed between editions. The Q4 2024 edition shows Kohala Coast 1,364 sales (35%) and Kona 90 (2%). The Q4 2025 edition restates 2024 as Kohala Coast 699 and Kona 754; the combined total is about the same (1,454 vs 1,453). For district year-over-year comparisons, use the restated prior-period column of the later edition.

District names were matched to the foot-row totals as the only assignment consistent with each panel's published island-share %, its HI/US/foreign pie % (within 0.75 pt) and its HI count. All 25 island records produced a unique match. District panels also list top states and countries with dollar amounts; only the HI row and the totals are carried into this JSON.

PDF extraction issues: in Maui Q4 2024 (page 1), pdftotext puts the HI (1029, $1.1B) and AZ (19, $59.1M) values on a separate line from their labels. The pdfplumber coordinates put each value 2pt below its own label, inside the same row band, so the pairing is confirmed. Kauai Q1 2026 contains a stray hidden text fragment ('This formula result ...') in the foreign column, which was ignored. All other state, country and total values were found as contiguous text in pdftotext -layout output (pull/tg/crosscheck.py: 646 of 648 tokens matched; the 2 exceptions are the Maui rows above).

Anomalies kept as published, not corrected: Hawaii Island Hilo district 2024 lists CA = 232 buyers / $35.0M (the same in the Q4 2024 and Q4 2025 editions) against 29 in 2025, and Hilo total sales fall from 668 (2024) to 456 (2025). The source gives no cause. Kauai Lihue Jan-Jun 2025 = 170 sales vs 66 in Jan-Jun 2026.

Country labels are as printed: 'Korea' (presumably South Korea); 'England' (Maui 2025) and 'United Kingdom' (other editions) are kept separate; 'Mariana Islands' (Q1 2026 Oahu and Statewide) is listed by TG as foreign even though the Northern Mariana Islands is a US territory; 'Cook Islands' and 'Cayman Islands' also appear.
Privacy: the source PDFs contain only aggregates, with no owner names or addresses. This JSON contains only aggregate counts and dollar volumes.

district_pairing.status: confirmed (unique assignment consistent with published share%, pie% and HI count)

checks.sum_ok_definition: true when: sum of district (US TOTAL + FOREIGN TOTAL) equals the island total_sales; published HI/other-US/foreign sales shares match counts within rounding; top-10 states and top countries do not exceed their totals. A full state-by-state sum is impossible because only the top 10 states are published.
